sloka: एवम् उक्तः तु सोउमित्रिः सुग्रीव सचिवम् कपिम् ।अभ्यभाषत वाक्यज्ञो वाक्यज्ञम् पवनात्मजम् ॥४-३-३६॥
transliteration: evam uktaḥ tu soumitriḥ sugrīva sacivam kapim ।abhyabhāṣata vākyajño vākyajñam pavanātmajam ॥4-3-36॥

translations.english: Thus instructed, Saumitri who was equally skilled in speach replied to Sugriva's minister, son of the Windgod
